# Gomzo
> Official website: [https://gomzo.co/](https://gomzo.co/) — Discover welcoming homestays and short stays across cities, with host-reviewed booking requests.

## About Gomzo
Gomzo is a multi-city accommodation discovery and booking-request platform for travellers, families and work trips. Guests can explore published homes, compare details and request dates; hosts review requests, and a stay is confirmed after payment verification. Live listings vary by city.

## Core Pages & Offerings
- [Home](https://gomzo.co/): Explore the currently published collection of stays.
- [Pune stays](https://gomzo.co/stays/pune): City-specific guidance and listings when available.
- [About Gomzo](https://gomzo.co/about): Platform, host management and booking approach.
- [How booking works](https://gomzo.co/how-it-works): Booking requests, host review, payment and confirmation.
- [Frequently asked questions](https://gomzo.co/faq): Answers about prices, dates, cancellations and booking status.
- [Contact Gomzo](https://gomzo.co/contact): Booking and stay assistance.
- [Privacy](https://gomzo.co/privacy): Privacy and personal data information.

## Frequently Asked Questions
- **What is Gomzo?**
  Gomzo helps travellers discover homestays, private apartments and short stays across cities. Guests browse published homes, check details and dates, and send a booking request. Hosts review requests, and the stay becomes confirmed after payment verification. Live availability depends on each property and date.
- **What services does Gomzo offer?**
  Gomzo offers a searchable collection of published accommodation, property details, date and guest selection, booking requests, and booking-status updates. Hosts can manage listings and availability. The cities and homes available at a given time are shown in the live collection and may change.
- **How can customers get started with Gomzo?**
  Visit Gomzo, browse the published stays, choose a property and dates, and review the quote and property details. Sign in to submit a booking request. The host reviews it; after acceptance, follow the payment instructions. The host confirms the stay after verifying payment.
